MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Echo Show 8 feels like a useful addition to my Fire TV and security-camera setup because its screen could let me view compatible cameras while adding Alexa control.",
    "The smart plug offers a concrete new convenience: controlling a lamp by voice alongside my existing Alexa-enabled devices."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Another HD Fire TV Stick adds little because I already have a 4K stick and a Fire TV television; familiarity alone does not give me a reason to choose it.",
    "The tablets and Echo Auto serve needs I have not shown, while the memory cards require a specific storage need and confirmed compatibility before they would appeal to me.",
    "The smaller Show and Echo speakers fit my interests, but choosing the Show 8 makes those additional devices less useful right now."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Owning Amazon home devices seems to have been taken as interest in almost any Amazon device, including tablets and a car accessory.",
    "My streaming purchases seem to have been treated as a reason to buy more streaming hardware even when it repeats something I already own."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent choices center on home viewing and security, so an addition needs a clear role in that setup.",
    "I care about what a device adds beyond my existing equipment, including whether it works with my cameras and whether one chosen device already covers the same purpose."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "You recognized my interest in connected home electronics, but stretched it into related devices without enough attention to usefulness, compatibility, and what I already own."
}
